title: Compute Coulomb coefficient C_A-ORot
action: Implement the Ewald summation method for the cubic perovskite ABO₃ lattice (A at (0,0,0), B at (0.5,0.5,0.5), O1 at (0.5,0.5,0), O2 at (0.5,0,0.5), O3 at (0,0.5,0.5)). Compute the Coulomb coefficient matrix in the Cartesian basis for wave vectors q=(ξ,ξ,0) with ξ from 0 to 0.5 (step 0.02). Transform to the Σ₃ irreducible representation basis (p_A, p_ORot, etc.) using the definitions in the paper's Eq. (1). Extract the C_A-ORot coefficient. Write a CSV file named coulomb_coefficients.csv with columns xi and C_A_ORot.
description: CSV table of C_A-ORot Coulomb coefficient vs. ξ along Γ-M.
output_schema: columns: xi (float, dimensionless fractional coordinate), C_A_ORot (float, same dimensionless units as paper). Rows for xi = 0.00, 0.02, ..., 0.50.

title: Compute stiffness dispersion
action: Construct the total stiffness matrix S = M + diag(α_A⁻¹, α_B⁻¹, α_O-A⁻¹, α_O-A⁻¹, α_O-B⁻¹) using the Coulomb coefficient matrix M in the Σ₃ basis (computed via the same Ewald implementation as step 1) and the given polarizabilities: α_A=4.9, α_B=0.37, α_O-A=4.38, α_O-B=2.9 (units Å³). Compute the lowest eigenvalue of S for each q along Γ-M (same q-grid). Write a CSV file named stiffness_dispersion.csv with columns xi and S_min.
description: Lowest eigenvalue of the total stiffness matrix vs. xi.
output_schema: columns: xi (float), S_min (float, same energy scale as paper). Rows for xi = 0.00, 0.02, ..., 0.50.
